author: Devi Garcia

barWidget.description: Icon badge for pending Arch repo, AUR, mise, plugin, and theme updates, with a click-to-open panel listing every pending package and its old -> new version. Nerd Font package icon when clean, package-variant icon plus count when updates are waiting. Click for the list, middle-click to refresh, right-click to update.

description: Shows pending Arch repo, AUR, mise, shell plugin, and theme updates as a Nerd Font icon badge: package icon when clean, package-variant icon plus count when updates are waiting. Click opens a panel listing every pending package per category with its old -> new version; middle-click refreshes the check, right-click runs the updater.
name: arch-updates
